problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — Shettihalli (2019–2020)
problem_summary: 9 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in Shettihalli between January 2019 and September 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 56% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

agency_attribution_note: 9 of 9 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.37). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=0.67, unresolved_rate=0.56, complaint_volume=0.30.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Shettihalli' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Shettihalli for the period 2019–2020.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
